description: This PHP source file defines a class PerformanceReviewSearchFilterParams which extends FilterParams and uses traits for filtering performance review search queries within an HR management system. It includes constants for allowed sort fields and statuses, properties for various filter criteria, and getter/setter methods for those properties.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object class for encapsulating filter parameters used in searching performance reviews, with fields for employee number, reviewer, job title, subunit, status, date range, inclusion options, and sorting preferences.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: getReviewerEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the reviewer employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setReviewerEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the reviewer employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the job title ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getSubunitId
methods.description: Returns the subunit ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setSubunitId
methods.description: Sets the subunit ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getStatusId
methods.description: Returns the review status ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setStatusId
methods.description: Sets the review status ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the starting date for the review period filter.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the starting date for the review period filter.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the ending date for the review period filter.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the ending date for the review period filter.

methods.name: isExcludeInactiveReviews
methods.description: Indicates whether inactive reviews should be excluded.

methods.name: setExcludeInactiveReviews
methods.description: Sets whether to exclude inactive reviews.
